text:
A steel knife needs a cutting edge with a small surface area.
What is the reason for this?
A
A small surface area increases the pressure.
B
A small surface area increases the density of the steel.
C
A small surface area prevents the cutting edge from rusting.
D
A small surface area prevents the knife from becoming magnetised.

options.label: A
options.text: A small surface area increases the pressure.

options.label: B
options.text: A small surface area increases the density of the steel.

options.label: C
options.text: A small surface area prevents the cutting edge from rusting.

options.label: D
options.text: A small surface area prevents the knife from becoming magnetised.
